# CXNM - Standard - WIN - D - Legacy Hardening

The hardening settings from the old Administrative Templates policy for which OpenIntuneBaseline has no counterpart: hardened UNC paths, WDigest, blocking of device classes, multicast DNS and registry policy processing.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | Own hardening settings without a counterpart in OpenIntuneBaseline |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Legacy_Hardening.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Legacy_Hardening.json) |

> What remains of the old Administrative Templates policy (008) after OIB took over the rest: hardened UNC paths, WDigest, blocking of device classes, multicast DNS, LSA custom SSP/AP, MPR notifications, standby behaviour and Group Policy registry processing. Kept separate so that an OIB upgrade does not silently drag these settings along or throw them away.
